name: impresso-ocr-benchmark-impresso-nzz
description: An OCR benchmark focused on the NZZ subset of the IMPRESSO historical newspaper collection, measuring transcription and layout extraction quality for scanned archival pages. It is designed to evaluate OCR engines and document-layout models on real historical newspaper data with varied fonts and degradations.
reputation: Recognized within the historical-document and OCR research community as a useful, domain-specific benchmark for newspaper OCR quality evaluation.
